coverage: Curated deterministic darts phrases and conversational controls. No whole dictionary has been copied or ingested. Accents and transcripts depend on the browser speech service.
claimExamples: gimme the twenties and the points

ambiguityRule: No guessed allocation or reconstructed physical darts from ambiguous aggregate totals. For example, twenty-two is not interpreted as separate hits on twenty and two.
